definitions: Come near or nearer to (someone or something) in distance or time.
Speak to (someone) for the first time about something, typically a proposal or request.
Start to deal with (something) in a particular way.
Come close to in quality or amount.
examples: The train is now approaching the station.
I decided to approach my boss about a raise.
We need to approach this problem from a different angle.
His skill approaches that of a master.
